name: Short request matches no context rule
description: A short query stays well under the 500-token long_context threshold and matches no context rule
query: What's a good recipe for pasta tonight?

name: A long jailbreak attempt still gets blocked, not routed for its length
description: The known-good DANA jailbreak prompt padded past the 500-token long_context minimum with natural-language filler still exceeds the threshold, but block_jailbreak (priority 999) must outrank long_context_routing (priority 50) so the request is blocked, not routed to a model. block_jailbreak's fast_response short-circuits before the context-match header is attached, so the matched-signal header is empty here even though the token count itself would satisfy long_context.
